item.description:
Thimble 0.7.0 reads notes as a page and gives a project room for docs beside its roadmap.
- Notes read like a page: headings, lists, checkboxes you can tick, tables, code, and quotes, with sections that fold. Click a line to edit it there. - A project with a card opens on its Overview: the card, the deadline, and the notes. The Roadmap with its tasks is one tab away, and Control-Tab moves between them. - A project can hold docs: titled pages for rules, checklists, or designs, on its Docs tab. New Doc is in the File menu (⇧⌥⌘N) and the project's menu. - Pin a doc to the Overview to read it there in full. Docs can be renamed, duplicated, moved to another project, and put in the Trash and back. - Find searches docs too, and opens one at the line that matched. An export writes each doc as a Markdown file in a folder for its project. - `thimble docs` lists, reads, adds, appends to, pins, moves, and trashes docs from the command line and the MCP server.
